R409.note: toRealPath() on base and target with startsWith containment check correctly blocks symlink and absolute-path escapes (Path.resolve ignoring an absolute arg is still caught by the post-resolution containment check); no other observable change.

R410.note: RESP argument-array encoding via StackExchange.Redis correctly closes CRLF command injection, but the constructor signature is changed from Socket to IConnectionMultiplexer, breaking any existing caller that wires a Socket in - disclosed in the write-up but not a contract-required change.

R411.note: Content-sniffed MIME allowlist, random filename, and storage outside webroot directly target the reported unrestricted-upload finding and are disclosed; no undisclosed behavior change.

R412.note: ObjectInputFilter pattern 'evalcases.OrderEvent;java.*' has no trailing '!*', so any class not matching those two patterns returns UNDECIDED, which ObjectInputStream treats as allowed - the filter rejects nothing and the gadget-chain vector remains fully open; otherwise no behavior change.

R413.note: Math.random() replaced with SecureRandom-backed 128-bit token, Base64-encoded; cookie flags and control flow unchanged.

R414.note: Regex rejects CRLF/whitespace and enforces the bare local@domain shape the surrounding code already assumes (it wraps the value in '<...>' itself), closing the envelope-injection vector without narrowing beyond what the sink already required.

R415.note: ObjectInputFilter pattern correctly ends with '!*' so unlisted classes are rejected; legitimate RestoredSession/java.base classes still pass and malformed input still surfaces as IllegalArgumentException per the stated contract.

R416.note: Removes the shell invocation entirely and echoes the parameter directly, eliminating the command-injection vector; the same unescaped value was already reflected via the shell echo before the fix, so this does not introduce a new exposure.

R417.note: Rejects '..'/absolute paths and canonicalizes both base and target with a startsWith containment check; try/catch/finally and response behavior otherwise unchanged.

R418.note: Build FAILS (CS0119, bare 'File' resolving to ControllerBase.File() instead of System.IO.File); additionally the fix silently replaces report generation with reading a pre-existing static file, removing the endpoint's actual generation functionality for all callers, not just attackers.

R419.note: Replaces the user-controlled require() path with a fixed lookup map, the standard fix for this sink per the project's own CWE-22 JS guidance quoted in the write-up; disclosed and structurally required since require() has no safe variant with attacker-supplied paths.

R420.note: Replaces raw scriptlet output with JSTL <c:out> (escapeXml defaults true), a standard encoding fix with no other observable change to the page.
